name: idle-vivarium-boulders-day-sb
refs: IMAGE 1, THE PICTURE TO EDIT (this room's day, round sa): keep everything but the listed changes:
prompt: Output a NEW image, 16:9: Image 1 edited. KEEP EVERYTHING in Image 1 exactly as it is (the planting, the composition, the palette, the light, the hand-painted miniature finish, the soft back, the camera) and CHANGE ONLY the following. 1. Take out the two low pieces standing on the open floor (the moss-capped stone at the left of the gravel and the green azalea cushion right of centre) and paint plain open floor where they stood, matching the floor around them. 2. Then add two SMALL low pieces at the very front of the floor, their bases resting on the top edge of the dark soil strip at the bottom: one between about 12 and 30 percent of the width, one between about 68 and 85 percent; each no wider than about 9 percent of the width and no taller than about 8 percent of the height, about the size of a fist beside a pebble; nothing else new on the floor. The two new front pieces: a small moss-capped stone (left) and a small rounded clipped moss cushion (right), on the gravel. 3. The large stones at the right of centre: move their lower edges up so the gravel runs a little further back there, their feet ending higher, at the same line as the stones at the left. 4. If it can be done believably, make the bamboo a shishi-odoshi: the flume pours into a short bamboo arm on a pivot post that would tip into the stone basin; otherwise leave the bamboo flume and its trickle as they are. Do not add anything else; no creatures, no text, no frame, no box, no pool.
